note: External validation, round 2 (ROADMAP 6): three episodes from the history of mathematics. Mersenne's 1644 list (p = 67 entry, FALSE) against Cole's 1903 factorization; Euler's 1769 sum-of-powers conjecture at n = 5 (FALSE) against Lander and Parkin's 1966 counterexample; Euler's 1772 polynomial n^2 + n + 41 (FALSE as a universal claim) against its failure at n = 40. No statement here was invented for this suite and none of the verdicts is this repository's to set.
